next.config.js.name: Next static export settings
next.config.js.description: Requests output export and disables image optimization, allowing a static deployment rather than an application server.

package.json.name: Site package and build commands
package.json.description: Declares Next, React and development style/TypeScript dependencies and the standard development, build, start and lint commands; none were executed for this map.

postcss.config.js.name: CSS processing plugins
postcss.config.js.description: Configures Tailwind and Autoprefixer as PostCSS plugins.

src/app/gallery/page.tsx.name: Gallery page
src/app/gallery/page.tsx.description: Defines gallery metadata, explains that displayed cards are examples, mounts GalleryGrid and links to the contribution page.

src/app/globals.css.name: Global site styling
src/app/globals.css.description: Loads Tailwind layers, applies body and heading typography, and defines the fade-in animation used by page content.

src/app/history/page.tsx.name: Provisional park history
src/app/history/page.tsx.description: Renders historical prose, an approximate hardcoded timeline via Timeline, an attraction list and invitations to supply corrections.

src/app/layout.tsx.name: Shared root layout
src/app/layout.tsx.description: Loads display/body Google fonts through next/font, defines site metadata and places Navbar and Footer around page content.

src/app/page.tsx.name: Archive home page
src/app/page.tsx.description: Introduces the preservation project, links to history, gallery and contributions, presents example memories and includes the client-only newsletter component.

src/app/submit/page.tsx.name: Contribution page and tips
src/app/submit/page.tsx.description: Defines submission metadata and places SubmitForm beside static guidance about contextual details and consent.

src/app/virtual/page.tsx.name: Future virtual recreation proposal
src/app/virtual/page.tsx.description: Displays a staged vision for collecting, mapping, modeling and experiencing the park; implements no interactive recreation.

src/components/Footer.tsx.name: Shared footer links
src/components/Footer.tsx.description: Renders project background, volunteer/disclaimer text and links to the five public pages.

src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx.name: Client-side example filtering
src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx.description: Maintains selected category in React state, computes per-category counts from the local array and renders example MemoryCard components.

src/components/MemoryCard.tsx.name: Memory presentation card
src/components/MemoryCard.tsx.description: Displays category gradient, media-type icon, year, label and truncated story; example mode adds a badge instead of rendering a real media thumbnail.

src/components/Navbar.tsx.name: Responsive navigation
src/components/Navbar.tsx.description: Uses current pathname to highlight links and local state to open a mobile menu; links close the menu on selection.

src/components/NewsletterSignup.tsx.name: Newsletter placeholder
src/components/NewsletterSignup.tsx.description: Checks nonblank email text, prevents default submission and toggles a joined message; no mailing-list request or persistence exists.

src/components/SubmitForm.tsx.name: Memory submission placeholder
src/components/SubmitForm.tsx.description: Collects optional details, a capped story, local File objects and consent; supports drag/drop/removal and displays a local summary on submit without uploading or saving.

src/components/Timeline.tsx.name: Timeline renderer
src/components/Timeline.tsx.description: Maps supplied year/title/description entries to a styled ordered list; it does not fetch or verify historical claims.

src/data/memories.ts.name: Example memory types and array
src/data/memories.ts.description: Defines category and media types and six explicitly illustrative contributions used by the gallery rather than actual user records.

tailwind.config.ts.name: Tailwind source and theme settings
tailwind.config.ts.description: Selects app/component source templates and declares the jungle palette, font variables and sign drop shadow.

tsconfig.json.name: TypeScript compilation settings
tsconfig.json.description: Configures strict no-emit TypeScript checking, bundler module resolution, the Next plugin and the source import alias.
